htmlContent:
How to Automate Customer Calls Using AI

AI is transforming the face of customer service, with new and innovative ways to communicate for call center agents, such as using call technology to create voice agents to respond to customer calls and support the agents in their job.

Artificial intelligence can be used to enhance your customer service operations in the contact center.

In this article, I will look at how artificial intelligence can be used to automate customer calls in the contact center.

Understanding AI in Call Center

What is AI in Customer Service?

AI for customer service is where applications of artificial intelligence technologies can automate interactions and make customer interactions more efficient, using voice AI to make it easier for agents through call technology to respond to customer queries without delay, while also being able to focus on more complex issues.

This will range from basic support in the form of chatbots for simple questions and solutions to sophisticated AI voice agents that can solve complex queries and improve the customer experience with call technology.

The main objective of AI for customer service is to improve the customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and empower agents to respond to more complex customer needs while using call technology.

The use of conversational AI will enable businesses to automate customer support and ensure there are real-time, consistent responses across all customer touchpoints while also improving the customer experience and empowering agents’ quality of customer interaction using call technology.

Types of Call Centers Using AI

Numerous different types of call centers are now starting to use AI automation successfully, especially in creating AI agents that support the call center in providing better service and give agents the power to handle calls at scale through the call technology.

In general, for a call center specializing in inbound customer support that receives a lot of inquiries, AI platforms that build AI agents that can solve customer inquiries without contacting a human are replacing many traditional uses of call centers for inbound customer support, outbound phone calls, telemarketing, and other departments.

Technical support call centers, for instance, can build AI agents that can identify who has a certain problem and provide troubleshooting instructions to the customer, billing call centers can build AI agents that can call the customer for a balance inquiry or payment reminder and make the call for the agents at their call center much easier to do their work, and even emergency agencies have begun looking into building an AI platform that builds their inbound call agents.

Hence, they are not so overloaded on the front-end.

Any call center can benefit from the implementation of an AI call automation platform and the ability to build AI phone call agents that can support the call center.

Benefits of Call Center Automation

The advantages of call center automation are many, and it fundamentally changes the way you can handle your customer interfacing and puts your agents to train your AI as it learns to effectively and efficiently deal with calls at scale.

Most importantly, it enables automation of customer calls and achieves dramatic reductions in agent workload and operational costs, while enabling your global workforce to be more productive.

An AI voice agent (bot) or virtual agent (voice) can be used as an assistant to run through the needs and wants of customers, so your human agents can focus on the more complex issues requiring empathy, contextual problem-solving, and providing more satisfying customer experiences.

This enables higher customer satisfaction as the customer receives instant responses and a better overall customer experience through voice automation and call back later.

Voice automation and call backs not only make it possible to drive greater value in your customer interactions, but when empowered by the leading AI platform, also enable much better call routing, so that customers are getting directed as quickly as possible to the right person.

Implementing AI Voice Agents

What is an AI Voice Agent?

An AI voice agent is an intelligent software program that takes customer calls and automates their interactions using natural language processing (NLP) and voice recognition, a way for companies to create AI agents and improve service delivery.

It goes beyond having a simple IVR system that provides pre-recorded responses to basic questions, and instead, it is able to understand and respond to a complex, conversational, human-like voice, giving an experience to the customer akin to talking to a human agent who takes care of their needs.

These virtual agents are supported by state-of-the-art AI platforms that enable them to analyze astronomical data about the customer, learn from previous interactions, and deliver personalized, contextual service to customer support agents in real time.

The ultimate goal of an AI voice agent is to automate customer calls and sufficiently assist the customer to leave these calls on time and happy with the service, freeing human agents to dedicate their skills to more complex and emotional customer problems. These things require empathy and problem-solving skills.

This high level of automation with AI enables agents to work better with customers in real time with call technology.

How AI Voice Call Agents Work

AI phone agents utilize an advanced voice automation platform combining speech recognition, natural language understanding, and text-to-speech in order to allow voice agents to handle customer requests.

As the customer makes a fully automated phone call, the voice AI agent receives the input, converts voice into text, and then employs natural language understanding in order to determine the user's request and the current customer's needs.

Based on the natural language understanding, an AI agent can survey appropriate data, follow deeply scripted call flows, or make use of CRM in order to find the right response and answer customer inquiries instantly.

Using text-to-speech, virtual agents utter in a human-like way, so the whole interaction will be natural and seamless. The whole customer service interaction is enabled and powered by a conversational AI platform.

AI phone agents can instantly resolve the problem, fully automate customer support like FAQ answering, order processing, or first-level call routing, thus allowing human customer service representatives to focus better and solve more advanced customer issues.

Use Cases for AI Voice Call Agents in Customer Support

The range of how AI voice agents can be used in customer service is enormous, providing great potential for automating outbound calls and the use of AI for customer service to improve customer experience.

For example, an AI voice agent is much more likely to be able to efficiently handle a large volume of inbound queries by providing instant responses to frequently asked questions about, for example, product features, service statuses, or billing.

In addition, the same voice AI agent can efficiently handle general task requests, such as booking appointments and ordering products or services, as well as providing technical assistance that guides the user through troubleshooting processes.

Having these general, low-level customer interactions (such as standard calls to and from human customer service agents) handled by the AI platform for phone call automation will maximize the available resources for sensitive, complex, or high-value customer requirements.

How to Automate Calls with AI

Steps to Automate Phone Calls

Automating phone calls using AI enables a more seamless and effective customer experience.

Customer expectations can be managed using Skadi AI, and it allows agents to concentrate on higher-level, more complex questions. The initial phase involves defining the use cases where AI can add value, such as handling FAQs, facilitating bookings, or answering basic technical queries.

Once the use cases are defined, a suitable AI platform must be selected that has a strong conversational AI platform and a telephone call automation platform.

The next task is to train the AI voice agent on relevant customer data and typical customer needs to enhance the first call resolution.

Finally, experiments need to be run and performance monitored in order to drive efficiencies and enhance customer satisfaction, allowing the voice automation to learn.

Choosing the Right AI Call Solutions

Getting the right AI call solutions is an essential business process for many businesses that plan to automate calls, and it also depends significantly on the customer needs and the goals of the business to run successfully when considering customer retention.

One way to assess the optimal AI platform for your business is to compare available AI voice agents. Look at their potential to understand natural language and explore the need to seamlessly combine customer service with existing CRM systems and extend the scope and scale of the projects available.

To make the most of voice AI platforms, your preferred solutions should have a high-quality call routing system, so that when an escalation need arises, a customer service call can be escalated to the next level seamlessly in case the conversation becomes too complex for the AI call agents, without frustrating the customer.

Finally, the level of support and maintenance is also important as the AI agents have to be continuously updated and reconfigured to help with customer retention and customer satisfaction.

Common Challenges in Call Automation

Although there are many benefits to automation of phone calls, there are also some common challenges that companies face in implementing a conversational AI platform successfully and achieving higher first call resolutions.

A challenge is ensuring that the voice agent is able to understand any nuance, such as accents or multi-parallel utterances, as a failure to understand can defeat the purpose of the verbal conversation and cause customer frustration, therefore impacting the levels of customer satisfaction.

Moreover, connecting the platform with existing legacy systems can be time-consuming and complex for the agents who handle customer queries through call support, which becomes inevitable, but the outcome empowers the agents to serve customers better.

Ultimately, the language needs of customers should be addressed when using the AI agent. Still, sometimes the sensitive or emotional customer needs are met better with traditional call support, thus balancing out automation with the need for the human touch.

Hence, the company should create clear call flows in an organization for when a call automatically transfers to the human agent.

Future of Automation in Call Centers

Trends in AI and Customer Support

What is coming in the future of AI in customer support? AI innovation is at the forefront of customer support, and many disruptive trends will converge with AI to produce incredible improvements in customer support automation and ultimately provide better customer experience and increased customer retention.

Expect to see: the proliferation of more intelligent and more competent AI agents that would not only rely on decision rules to address simple questions effectively, but can predict customers' future needs, and offer solutions to those needs immediately by taking account of the customer's current situation;

This includes the enhanced implementation of conversational AI and real-time customer interaction, making it very difficult for customers to tell the difference between a bot and a human, as well as industry-focused, specialized AI platforms designed to deeply understand a specific niche for varied, customized, and highly effective customer support automation.

As the customer support industry continues to evolve, call centers will struggle less and less to do customer support as long as they can tap into AI automation to support the work of the customer support call center agents.

Impact of AI on Call Center Human Agents' Work

The growing implementation of AI in call centers signifies the future of human agents away from monotonous, repetitive call work to more challenging and emotionally involved customer needs and call requirements, which the human agents then handle.

Instead of fully replacing human agents, AI tools are to essentially automate the common customer call, further allowing human agents to excel in complex tasks that demand human emotional guile and customer relationship skills.

Call center automation will ultimately empower human agents by providing them with more comprehensive, instant data about the customer for higher-quality interactions, building upon the inherent strengths of the human agent to deliver a more professional customer experience, and maintaining customer satisfaction and loyalty.

Henceforth, human agents will work in collaboration with AI agents, unleashing the strengths of both agents to foster AI-based call support agents ultimately, so they can shine at their jobs and gain higher customer retention through AI-led customer interactions.

Potential Developments in AI Voice Technology

The possibilities for future AI voice technology are very exciting as AI agents enhance the interactions with existing customers and also allow agents to leverage call technology to revolutionize customer service delivery.

Our predictions include advanced natural language understanding that allows AI phone agents to understand complex answers and more subtle customer needs (e.g., hidden sentiment and dialect differences), increased interactivity and more natural-sounding text-to-speech, such that automated phone calls are indistinguishable from human, 'call in real time,’ and integration of multimodal AI (such as voice with contextual info gained from other media) allowing for an even more natural, customer attentive experience that increases customer satisfaction.
